date_note: The page gives only its publication day (Anadolu Agency report, 24 November 2026).
title: Italy's ACN warns firms and infrastructure operators about risks of autonomous AI agents
summary: Italy's National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN) called on companies and infrastructure operators to take precautions against the risks of autonomous AI agents, according to an Anadolu Agency report carried by Haberler.com. The agency said it had detected agents used in automated attack campaigns. It said agents can act within seconds and shorten attack timelines compared with human attackers.
plain: Italy's cyber agency says it has seen autonomous AI agents used in automated attacks and urges companies and infrastructure operators to take precautions.
exec: Italy's cyber agency, as reported by Anadolu, says AI agents can act within seconds, so organisations are urged to act on its advice.
action: ACN advises keeping system security updates current, cutting risky connections, blocking internet traffic when a problem arises until corrective measures are in place, protecting credentials, reducing the attack surface and monitoring for unusual behaviour.

validation.note: Two publishers read, each stating that ACN warned of autonomous AI agent risks: Haberler.com (Anadolu Agency) and L'Adige (ANSA). ACN's own page was not read.

review.note: stronger than the source and action advice: adapt attacks -> act within seconds, operation times -> attack timelines, removed added word outbound
